description: This file contains image comparison utilities, including functions for pixel drawing, color difference calculation, and image similarity metrics such as SSIM. It exports a compare function that highlights differences between two images.

classes.name: FastStats
classes.description: Class for calculating fast statistical measures, such as variance, used in image comparison.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two image buffers and optionally outputs a diff image highlighting differences, using color difference and SSIM metrics.
